author: Nico_Sama
quote: Game runs like crap at 20 FPS, the story is absolutely lame unlike any GTA in the past and you conveniently can't refund the game, I genuinely consider GTA VI to be a scam. Rockstar should be ashamed of themselves for releasing this slop and likewise should all the paid off "critics" that gave it a perfect score. No redeeming factors whatsoever 0/10.
